import java.io.*;

public class _1599_C {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] tokens = in.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(tokens[0]);
        double p = Double.parseDouble(tokens[1]);
        int total = choose3(n);
        int i = 1;
        while (i <= n) {
            double probability = chance(i, n, total);
            if (probability >= p) {
                System.out.println(i);
                break;
            }
            i++;
        }
        in.close();
    }

    private static double chance(int i, int n, int total) {
        return ((double) i * choose2(n - i) / total) / 2.0
                + (double) choose2(i) * (n - i) / total
                + (double) choose3(i) / total;
    }

    private static int choose2(int n) {
        if (n < 2) return 0;
        return n * (n - 1) / 2;
    }

    private static int choose3(int n) {
        if (n < 3) return 0;
        return n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 6;
    }
}

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

public class _1599_C {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(in.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        double p = Double.parseDouble(st.nextToken());
        int total = chooseThree(n);
        OptionalInt answer = IntStream.rangeClosed(1, n)
                .filter(i -> probability(i, n, total) >= p)
                .findFirst();
        answer.ifPresent(System.out::println);
        in.close();
    }

    private static double probability(int i, int n, int total) {
        return (double) i * chooseTwo(n - i) / total / 2.0
                + (double) chooseTwo(i) * (n - i) / total
                + (double) chooseThree(i) / total;
    }

    private static int chooseTwo(int n) {
        return n < 2 ? 0 : n * (n - 1) / 2;
    }

    private static int chooseThree(int n) {
        return n < 3 ? 0 : n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 6;
    }
}

    static class FastScanner {
        private final InputStream in = System.in;
        private int next = -2;

        private int read() throws IOException {
            if (next != -2) {
                int c = next;
                next = -2;
                return c;
            }
            return in.read();
        }

        private int peek() throws IOException {
            if (next == -2) {
                next = in.read();
            }
            return next;
        }

        private void skipWhitespace() throws IOException {
            int c = peek();
            while (c != -1 && c <= ' ') {
                read();
                c = peek();
            }
        }

        public String next() throws IOException {
            skipWhitespace();
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            int c = peek();
            while (c != -1 && c > ' ') {
                sb.append((char) c);
                read();
                c = peek();
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public double nextDouble() throws IOException {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }
    }
